title: Meta pushes AI model 'Avocado' rollout to May or later, NYT reports
title_zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，Meta 将人工智能模型“Avocado”的推出时间推至 5 月或更晚
summary: Meta has postponed the release of its artificial intelligence model "Avocado" to at least May, from this ‌month, the New York Times reported on Thursday, citing sources.
summary_zh: 据《纽约时报》周四援引消息人士称，Meta 已将其人工智能模型“Avocado”的发布从本月起至少推迟到 5 月。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures climb after stocks sink to lowest levels since November
title_zh: 今日股市：道指、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货在股市跌至 11 月以来最低水平后上涨
summary: Oil prices continue to surge as the Iran war escalates, damaging supply chains across the region.
summary_zh: 随着伊朗战争升级，石油价格继续飙升，损害了整个地区的供应链。

title: Amazon plans to move Prime Day event to June from July, Bloomberg News reports
title_zh: 据彭博社报道，亚马逊计划将 Prime Day 活动从 7 月移至 6 月
summary: March 12 (Reuters) - Amazon.com is planning to move its Prime Day sale event up to late June, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday, marking a rare shift in calendar for the critical, decade-old
summary_zh: 路透 3 月 12 日 - 据彭博社周四报道，亚马逊计划将 Prime Day 促销活动推迟至 6 月下旬，这标志着长达 10 年之久的关键日历的罕见转变

title: Stryker flags disruption to orders, manufacturing a day after cyberattack
title_zh: 网络攻击一天后，史赛克 (Stryker) 表示订单和生产中断
summary: March 12 () - Medical device maker Stryker said on Thursday a cyberattack that ‌hit its computer systems a day ‌earlier is causing widespread disruption to its business, including ​its ability to process orders, make products and ship them to customers.
summary_zh: 3 月 12 日 () - 医疗设备制造商史赛克 (Stryker) 周四表示，一天前袭击其计算机系统的网络攻击正在对其业务造成广泛干扰，包括其处理订单、制造产品并将其运送给客户的能力。

title: SentinelOne's quarterly profit forecast falls short of estimates amid stiff competition
title_zh: 竞争激烈，SentinelOne季度盈利预测不及预期
summary: Cybersecurity firm SentinelOne forecast quarterly profit below Wall Street estimates on Thursday, signaling a cautious stance ‌amid intense competition from larger rivals and a finance leadership ‌transition.
summary_zh: 网络安全公司 SentinelOne 周四预测季度利润低于华尔街预期，这表明在来自较大竞争对手的激烈竞争和财务领导层过渡的情况下采取谨慎立场。

title: Tech Giants Hover on Cusp of a Correction as War Heats Up
title_zh: 随着战争升温，科技巨头徘徊在调整的风口浪尖
summary: Bloomberg’s gauge of Magnificent Seven companies — which includes titans like Nvidia Corp., Apple Inc. and Tesla Inc. — closed  lower and is close to being down 10% from its October peak.
summary_zh: 彭博社对七大公司（包括英伟达公司、苹果公司和特斯拉公司等巨头）的指数收盘走低，较 10 月份的峰值下跌了近 10%。

title: S&P Weighs Rule Changes That Would Speed SpaceX’s S&P 500 Entry
title_zh: 标准普尔正在权衡规则变化，以加快 SpaceX 进入标准普尔 500 指数的速度
summary: Funds that track the index must buy newly added stocks, and roughly $24 trillion is tied to the S&P 500, according to Bloomberg Intelligence.  Any change to the S&P 500’s rules would be momentous.  A spokesperson for SpaceX didn’t immediately respond to a request for comment.
summary_zh: 据 Bloomberg Intelligence 称，跟踪该指数的基金必须购买新增股票，大约 24 万亿美元与标准普尔 500 指数挂钩。  标准普尔 500 指数规则的任何改变都将是重大的。  SpaceX 发言人没有立即回应置评请求。

title: Energy ETF extends record run, Firefly Aerospace's successful launch
title_zh: 能源ETF延续创纪录运行，萤火虫航天成功推出
summary: Yahoo Finance anchor Josh Lipton tracks today's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute. US stocks move lower as oil prices rise, with conflict in the Middle East spooking investors.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经主播乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 在本《市场分钟》中追踪当今走势最强劲的股票和最大的市场故事。随着油价上涨，美国股市走低，中东冲突令投资者感到不安。

title: Atlassian job cuts raise the question: Is AI driving layoffs?
title_zh: Atlassian 裁员引发了一个问题：人工智能是否会导致裁员？
summary: Atlassian (TEAM) plans to cut about 10% of its workforce as it shifts more resources toward artificial intelligence (AI).
summary_zh: Atlassian (TEAM) 计划裁员约 10%，以将更多资源转向人工智能 (AI)。
